content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional payment [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-4|infrastructure]] designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/problem-selling-digital-downloads-pakistan-how-solve-base-2|The Problem]] in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

Traditional platforms like PayPal, Stripe, and Gumroad offer user-friendly interfaces and a semblance of security. However, these come with significant limitations, including severe geographic restrictions and the risk of account suspensions. For instance, PayPal can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal, impacting creators' cash flow. In contrast, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells-15|COREMERCH guide to sovereign]] commerce infrastructure allows creators to build and own their digital stores using free tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, providing complete control over their sales and payments.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal explicitly exclude users from several countries, leaving creators in those regions without viable options for selling digital products. This exclusion is not merely a minor inconvenience; it's a significant barrier that stifles creativity and entrepreneurship. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, is designed to empower all creators, irrespective of their location. By utilizing tools that are not bound by regional restrictions, such as Supabase and Google Drive, creators can build fully functional online stores without the fear of account bans or fund seizures.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing on traditional platforms often involves high fees, long waiting periods, and a lack of transparency. For instance, Stripe charges fees based on transaction amounts, which can add up quickly for creators. In contrast, NOWPayments provides a flat 0.5% fee for crypto transactions, ensuring that creators retain more of their earnings. Additionally, the payment verification process is automated and instantaneous, allowing creators to deliver products immediately upon purchase, eliminating the delays typically experienced with conventional platforms.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full control over your digital store.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With platforms like Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy, creators do not have full ownership of their digital products or customer data. They are dependent on these platforms for hosting and payment processing, which poses a risk if those platforms change their policies or shut down. Sovereign commerce infrastructure grants creators full ownership of their digital stores and customer information, allowing for automation in delivery and payment processing without the threat of platform dependency. This architecture ensures that creators can scale their businesses without the fear of losing access to their products or data.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators in restricted countries seeking a reliable method to sell their ebooks, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) stands out as a robust choice. It offers a fully integrated solution with Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, ensuring that creators can build a scalable and sovereign e-commerce platform within 48 hours. Those who prefer a more manual approach might consider piecing together various free tools, but this can lead to inefficiencies and potential issues in integration.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Never rely on a platform that can suspend your account and hold your funds.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
